cards.name: Bombadil's Song
cards.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +1/+1 and gains hexproof until end of turn. The Ring tempts you. (A creature with hexproof can't be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control.)

cards.name: Titania's Song
cards.oracleText: Each noncreature artifact loses all abilities and becomes an artifact creature with power and toughness each equal to its mana value. If this enchantment leaves the battlefield, this effect continues until end of turn.

cards.name: Song of the Dryads
cards.oracleText:
Enchant permanent
Enchanted permanent is a colorless Forest land.

cards.name: Cancel
cards.oracleText: Counter target spell.

cards.name: Swan Song
cards.oracleText: Counter target enchantment, instant, or sorcery spell. Its controller creates a 2/2 blue Bird creature token with flying.

cards.name: Song of Eärendil
cards.oracleText:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Scry 2, then draw two cards.
II — Create a Treasure token and a 2/2 blue Bird creature token with flying.
III — Put a flying counter on each creature you control without flying.

cards.name: Firesong and Sunspeaker
cards.oracleText:
Red instant and sorcery spells you control have lifelink.
Whenever a white instant or sorcery spell causes you to gain life, Firesong and Sunspeaker deals 3 damage to target creature or player.
printedNames: Canção do Fogo e Voz Solar

cards.name: Song of the Worldsoul
cards.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, populate. (Create a token that's a copy of a creature token you control.)

cards.name: Songs of the Damned
cards.oracleText: Add {B} for each creature card in your graveyard.

cards.name: Seething Song
cards.oracleText: Add {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.

cards.name: Torch Song
cards.oracleText:
At the beginning of your upkeep, you may put a verse counter on this enchantment.
{2}{R}, Sacrifice this enchantment: It deals X damage to any target, where X is the number of verse counters on this enchantment.

cards.name: Song of Creation
cards.oracleText:
You may play an additional land on each of your turns.
Whenever you cast a spell, draw two cards.
At the beginning of your end step, discard your hand.

cards.name: Song of Serenity
cards.oracleText: Creatures that are enchanted can't attack or block.

cards.name: Song of Totentanz
cards.oracleText: Create X 1/1 black Rat creature tokens with "This token can't block." Creatures you control gain haste until end of turn.

cards.name: Song of Inspiration
cards.oracleText:
Choose up to two target permanent cards in your graveyard. Roll a d20 and add the total mana value of those cards.
1—14 | Return those cards to your hand.
15+ | Return those cards to your hand. You gain life equal to their total mana value.

cards.name: Love Song of Night and Day
cards.oracleText:
Read ahead (Choose a chapter and start with that many lore counters. Add one after your draw step. Skipped chapters don't trigger. Sacrifice after III.)
I — You and target opponent each draw two cards.
II — Create a 1/1 white Bird creature token with flying.
III — Put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two target creatures.
printedNames: Canção de Amor da Noite e do Dia

cards.name: Song of Freyalise
cards.oracleText:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I, II — Until your next turn, creatures you control gain "{T}: Add one mana of any color."
III — Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control. Those creatures gain vigilance, trample, and indestructible until end of turn.

cards.name: Eriette's Lullaby
cards.oracleText: Destroy target tapped creature. You gain 2 life.

cards.name: Iceberg Cancrix
cards.oracleText: Whenever another snow permanent you control enters, you may have target player mill two cards.

cards.name: Song of Stupefaction
cards.oracleText:
Enchant creature or Vehicle
When this Aura enters, you may mill two cards. (You may put the top two cards of your library into your graveyard.)
Fathomless descent — Enchanted permanent gets -X/-0, where X is the number of permanent cards in your graveyard.

cards.name: Song of Blood
cards.oracleText: Mill four cards. Whenever a creature attacks this turn, it gets +1/+0 until end of turn for each creature card put into your graveyard this way.
